data.title: 神罚 · 玫瑰水汽的静谧私汤
data.description: 水汽氤氲的热石浴池中漂浮着绯红的玫瑰花瓣。神罚浸在清澈温热的泉水中，湿漉微卷的银白发丝贴在发烫微红的雪白肩头。她双手合拢捧起一掬温水，目光羞怯而含情脉脉地抬起视线，水珠顺着精致的锁骨滑落，呈现出毫无防备的动人风致。
data.location: luxury private bathroom with steam and warm candlelight
data.action: soaking in steaming marble bath with floating rose petals, wet silver hair clinging to bare shoulders, holding water in cupped hands, water droplets on collarbone, sweet shy blush
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight reflecting on steamy water ripples
data.mood: serene sensual relaxation, pure trusting warmth
data.promptProse: Soaking in a warm candlelit marble bath adorned with floating rose petals, Modernia looks up with blushing cheeks and wet silver bob hair. Dewy droplets glisten on her bare collarbones in the warm steam.
data.animaCaption: Modernia soaking in a candlelit rose petal bath with blushing cheeks and wet silver hair.
